title: vixen-native.sh: a lane-rule export of VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE to the WSL worktree path breaks the native configure
body: Lane rules say set VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<worktree>/.tmp/fetch; exporting that WSL path into a native Windows build made FetchContent run its subbuild from a UNC cwd (cmd.exe: UNC paths are not supported) and configure failed (sn-gb0:native-build). The script's own default is correct (a /mnt/c path under the native checkout). Either the rule should say native builds leave it unset, or the script should ignore a non-/mnt value.

title: Seeding a native checkout's FetchContent cache: the copy costs 11 min and the subbuild CMakeCache holds the source checkout's absolute paths
body: A new native checkout (gb0) copied loadscene1's .tmp/fetch (1.2 GB, 11 min over /mnt/c) and configure then failed: CMakeCache.txt directory is different than the directory where it was created. Remedy: delete every *-subbuild and *-build directory, keep only *-src. A verb (vixen-native.sh seed-cache FROM_LANE) or a shared read-only src cache removes the copy and the trap; sharing one cache dir between two native checkouts (sequential builds) worked for gb0-base.

title: box-queue --resource bench: a waiting job is refused with bench-not-taken-open-timeout after 30 to 90 min and nothing retries it
body: sn-gb0 needed 11 quiet runs; the first admission took four refusals over about 4 h (blocking: long sg-suite and coverage-shard jobs holding the drain), then the window stayed open and later runs were admitted within minutes. A lane wraps the job in a retry loop (chain.sh in reports/sn-gb0-evidence) and deletes the half-created evidence directory between tries. A queue-side retry-until-admitted, or a window held for the requester's follow-on jobs, removes the loop.
